name: belt-v1
description: Belt-mounted activity and fall research; parameters are starting values, not validated performance claims.
fall_evaluation: Use separate human-annotated event intervals and continuous monitored exposure with fall_eval.py; window accuracy is not fall-event sensitivity.
notes: Keep belt position, orientation and enclosure revision in session metadata. Review clipping at the firmware's current +/-4g range. The legacy wrist model must be retrained; do not enable it as a belt fall detector.
